attempts.summary: Configured sudo command logging on node1: sudo now logs via syslog facility local2 (Defaults syslog=local2 in /etc/sudoers.d/sudo-syslog), and rsyslog routes local2.* to a dedicated /var/log/sudo-commands.log with a stop directive so entries never reach /var/log/messages or /var/log/secure. Verified logging works (user + timestamp + command recorded), verified isolation from general logs, and completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol (boot_id changed, config and log persisted, logging pipeline confirmed working post-restart).
